statements.t: Based on those data, we have engaged with the FDA on our plans for a registrational study in the front-line setting and plan to initiate that study in the first half of next year.
In addition, we plan to engage with regulators on the possibility of seeking accelerated approval of this combination in second line pancreatic cancer.
Beyond pancreatic cancer, we look forward to sharing our strategy in lung cancer, supported by data from vopimetostat and TNG456, in January of next year.
I am grateful to the dedicated Tango team for the progress we have made in 2026 thus far and look forward to advancing our mission of bringing these important therapies to patients with cancer.”

Based upon the encouraging Phase 1/2 data and discussions with the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA), Tango intends to initiate a pivotal Phase 3 study of the combination of vopimetostat plus daraxonrasib in front-line MTAP-deleted pancreatic cancer.
The Company anticipates that this will be a global, randomized study of vopimetostat 200 mg plus daraxonrasib 100 mg, once-daily vs. standard-of-care chemotherapy.
The Company plans to initiate the study in the first half of 2027.

In October 2026, the Company announced that it plans to initiate a Phase 1/2 combination study of vopimetostat plus panRAS inhibitors in patients with MTAP-wild type pancreatic cancer in the first half of 2027.
In October 2026, Tango disclosed a strategic reprioritization of the Company’s research and development activities to focus on the advancement of PRMT5-targeted therapies.
As of September 30, 2026, the Company held $977.5 million in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities, which the Company expects to fund its current operating plan.
statements.was: As of June 30, 2026, the Company held $1.0 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities, which the Company expects to fund its current operating plan.

dropped.t: I am pleased with the progress we have made against executing on our clinical development plan, which is well on track, and the team continues to be laser-focused on bringing vopimetostat to patients as soon as possible.
